name: REA Workbench
summary: QEMU-backed Windows analysis workbench: lifecycle, dual guest agents, T2 introspection, kernel ETW telemetry, copy-on-write file broker, and external-observation evidence export.

provides: start/stop/status for one local QEMU Windows guest
basic machine profile seed: CPU, RAM, MAC, disk serial, SMBIOS, with host/guest consistency check
qcow2 offline snapshots and restore (WHPX may refuse running savevm)
host-to-guest file staging through a shared removable disk
dual guest agent channels: privileged control on 45999 and interactive launch on 45998
T2 introspection: processes, services, autoruns, event logs, DNS cache, TCP/UDP endpoints, registry read/write, and deep identity
Profile Broker: registry identity apply with a SYSTEM startup persistence task, plus firmware/registry/WMI cross-layer verification
kernel ETW collection (process/file/registry/network) with host-side tracerpt summaries
copy-on-write file broker: lower staging, deploy, guest diff, harvest to upper, and host commit with backups
chunked guest file copy with SHA-256 verification on both sides
QEMU gdbstub register/memory access and breakpoints
runtime packet capture through QEMU filter-dump
external-observation evidence directory with a SHA-256 manifest
excludes: a transparent guest file-I/O proxy or C:\ path redirection; the broker is explicit deploy/harvest, not a minifilter
guest memory introspection beyond bounded physical-memory dumps and the gdbstub, or a VMI integration
anti-VM/anti-debug undetectability claims; agent, ETW, and gdbstub activity are observable
REA core Evidence records; evidence_export writes external observations only
running more than one workbench guest per host
boundaries.authority: The QEMU process and the installed guest image are the execution authority; the mod only controls their lifecycle and host-side staging.
prerequisites: QEMU 11.1 or newer with WHPX on Windows
the installed Windows 11 LTSC qcow2 and OVMF vars under the workbench home
local VNC access for GUI interaction

profiles.title: Windows 11 LTSC
profiles.summary: Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC 2024 Evaluation, Q35/OVMF, NVMe, e1000, local VNC.

usage: Open this package, then call status. Use start/stop for the QEMU guest, snapshot/restore for qcow2 state, and guest_channels to confirm both agent channels. Use guest_* tools for T2 introspection, telemetry_* for kernel ETW, profile_apply/profile_verify for identity layers, broker_* for copy-on-write file work, and evidence_export for an external-observation bundle. The default GUI endpoint is VNC 127.0.0.1:1.
